headline: Approved April 7, 2026 minutes, appointed Kate Jordan and Krystle Brown to policy subcommittee, and elected Thomas Piñeros-Shields vice chair.
summary: The meeting included presentations on community land trusts from Grounded Solutions and on Habitat for Humanity projects. Staff gave updates on SROs, transfer fees, 40R Districts, and the Jefferson Ave Corridor Plan. Members also approved the April 7, 2026 minutes and elected a vice chair.
decisions: Approved the April 7, 2026 minutes, all in favor.
Appointed Ms. Jordan and Mx. Brown to the policy subcommittee, all in favor.
Elected Mr. Pineros Shields as vice chair, all in favor.

plain_text:
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 through § 
2-2033. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
MEETING AGENDA 
 
A meeting of the Salem Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board was held on Tuesday, July 14, 2026, via 
remote participation. 
 
Acting Chair Pineros-Shields called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. 
 
Members present: Thomas Piñeros-Shields, Gina Flynn, Lynda-Fairbanks-Atlins, Kate Jordan, and 
Krystle Brown. 
 
Members absent: Mayor Pangallo, Chair Zamborlini (2) 
 
Staff present: Deputy Director Amanda Chiancola, Senior Planner Robyn Lee 
 
 
I. PUBLIC COMMENT 
 
There was no public comment. 
 
II. APPROVAL OF MINUTES 
A. April 7, 2026 
 
Motion to approve the April 7, 2026, minutes of the Affordable Housing Trust Fund is 
made Ms. Flynn, seconded by Ms. Fairbanks Atkins, all in favor. 
 
III. New Business 
 
4. Introduction of New Members 
 
The Trust welcomes two new members that have been appointed by the Mayor and 
confirmed by City Council, Kate Jordan and Krystle Brown.  
 
5. Guest Speakers 
 
a. Jason Webb, Community and Technical Assistance Principal from Grounded 
Solutions. 
a. Mr. Webb provides an overview of the process for implementing CLTs 
and how to first approach a CLT initiative. Presentation materials are 
available here. 
b. Kevin Hudson, Director of Charitable Giving from Essex County Habitat for 
Humanity. 
- - 
CITY OF SALEM 
AFFORDABLE HOUSING TRUST FUND BOARD
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 2-2028 through § 
2-2033. 
 
 
a. Mr. Hudson provides an overview of Habitat, how 
they acquire property, how they work with new homeowners, how 
they fund their projects, an overview of the new project proposed in 
Salem, and other Habitat programs. Presentation materials are 
available here. 
 
6. Committee Reports 
 
a. Update on fundraising from the fundraising subcommittee. 
a. Ms. Fairbanks Atkins provides an update on fundraising efforts. Staff 
and subcommittee members have been in ongoing 
conversations regarding the process for identifying the focus, 
implementation, and feasibility of these funds.  
 
b. Updates on research from the policy subcommittee. 
a. Mr. Pineros-Shields discusses a potential opportunity to explore 
making CLTs a topic of a research project led by SSU students starting 
in the fall. Ms. Jordan and Mx. Brown express interest in joining this 
subcommittee. 
 
*This vote is done later in the meeting after agenda item #7* 
Board votes to appoint Ms. Jordan and Mx. Brown to the policy subcommittee, all in favor. 
 
 
7. New Business 
 
a. Staff updates on Mayor’s housing priorities. 
a. Staff provide an update on efforts on SROs, transfer fees, 40R Districts, 
and Jefferson Ave Corridor Plan. Staff have been continuing work on 
SROs and transfer fees and aim to provide full updates and proposed 
policy frameworks to the Board at the next meeting. Development 
applications for Harrison Road and Margin St 40R districts are 
proceeding through local permitting or are expected to be filed soon. 
Staff will be presenting to the Committee of the Whole on the 
Jefferson Ave Corridor Plan on July 27th.  
 
b. Discuss and vote on vice chair. 
 
Motion to elect Mr. Pineros Shields as Vice Chairis made Ms. Flynn, seconded by Ms. Fairbanks Atkins, all 
in favor. 
 
8. Adjournment 
 
Motion to adjourn is made by  Ms. Flynn, seconded by Ms. Fairbanks Atkins, all in favor. 
 
Meeting adjourned at 8:29 PM
